jobs.title: Business Development Manager, Agentic Commerce
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will help build and execute Stripe’s strategy for agentic commerce. You will identify and launch lighthouse partnerships across AI agents, merchants, commerce platforms, marketplaces, and technology providers; move early opportunities from exploration to production; and turn market learning into repeatable go-to-market motions. You will work across Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions Architecture, Product Marketing, Legal, and Finance to position Stripe as critical infrastructure for agent-led commerce.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute Stripe’s go-to-market and ecosystem strategy for agentic commerce.
  • Build trusted relationships across AI companies and agent developers, merchants and brands, commerce platforms, marketplaces, and technology partners, creating mutually reinforcing adoption across the ecosystem.
  • Identify, cultivate, and launch lighthouse opportunities, moving partners from early exploration through technical validation, commercial alignment, production launch, and scaled adoption.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the distinct needs of buyers, agents, sellers, and ecosystem partners, and translate emerging use cases into viable technical and commercial solutions.
  • Shape and articulate Stripe’s agentic commerce narrative for technical, commercial, and executive audiences, including how Stripe enables secure checkout, identity and permissions, payment credentials, risk management, product discovery, and monetization.
  • Partner with core Account Executives, Solutions Architects, Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Legal, and Finance to structure solutions, partnerships, and emerging commercial models.
  • Build repeatable qualification, pilot, co-sell, activation, and scaling playbooks and enablement for Stripe’s broader field organization.
  • Create a structured voice-of-market loop that turns customer and partner signals into actionable product priorities, roadmap recommendations, and launch sequencing.
  • Represent Stripe with customers, partners, and industry audiences through EBCs, Sessions, Tours, and other strategic forums, helping establish Stripe as a leader in agentic commerce.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply.

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, product commercialization, or enterprise go-to-market, with meaningful experience in AI, developer platforms, commerce, fintech, or payments.
  • Demonstrated success taking a new product, market, or ecosystem motion from 0 to 1 and moving early partnerships or pilots into production.
  • Strong understanding of the AI ecosystem, including foundation models, agents, developer platforms, application-layer companies, and emerging protocols.
  • Technical fluency with APIs and platform architectures, including payments, identity and permissions, risk, payment credentials, and data flows, with the ability to engage credibly with product and engineering leaders.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships across AI startups, developer platforms, investors, and commerce ecosystems; existing Bay Area relationships are strongly preferred.
  • Experience developing complex, multi-party partnerships or two-sided ecosystems, with strong commercial judgment and the ability to align stakeholders with different incentives.
  • Excellent executive communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts and earn credibility with founders, product and engineering leaders, and enterprise executives.
  • Ability to operate effectively amid ambiguity, rapid product evolution, and incomplete market structure, and to lead cross-functional work without relying on formal authority.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe's Customer Success Managers (CSM) oversee the post-sales lifecycle for Stripe users, ensuring they realize the maximum value of their investment. This partnership drives user success, increases retention and expansion, and supports mutually beneficial renewal outcomes. Few roles provide such a direct impact on the growth of the company.

What you'll do

We are looking for a motivated and curious professional to manage a book of enterprise customers. The CSM will deliver proactive workshops, business reviews, payments insights, and thought leadership to help users grow their business.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented and meticulous, and enjoys engaging customers to investigate issues and deliver insights. This role involves working closely with sales, technical account managers, and operations teams to engage customers in product, payment, and technical conversations.

Responsibilities

• Partner closely with account executives and technical account managers to support post-sale engagements focused on the optimization, retention, and growth of Stripe's enterprise customers

• Manage a book of customers to drive overall account health including performance, product adoption, usage velocity, account renewals and growth, referrals, and customer satisfaction

• Serve as a trusted payments and product advisor to managed customers by delivering payment performance and industry insights

• Perform business reviews to align on user priorities, review payments performance metrics, share Stripe product roadmap, and provide guidance on how to optimize the value from Stripe

• Advocate for the customer to internal stakeholders. Share customer feedback and insights to Product Management, Engineering, Support, Marketing, and Sales on the innovation and improvement needed to optimize the Stripe user experience

• In coordination with an account team, support book expansion—identifying and surfacing opportunities to ensure customers are successful

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 4+ years of experience in a client-facing role in Enterprise relationship management, partnering with large, global, and complex organizations, working with a technical product

• Track record of leading technical conversations and persuading others to take action based on requirements and value provided by solutions

• Strong executive presence and presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders

• Proven track record of achieving targets and goals, preferably in a sales setting

• Has handled difficult customers or situations and can demonstrate resolutions

• The motivation and flexibility to work well in a high-growth environment where things change quickly

 

Preferred Qualifications

• History of success as a consultant, pre-sales, technical account management, or equivalent

• Strong business sense and understanding of underlying drivers and strategy of our user's businesses

• Track record of managing large, complex projects and programs

• Prior experience in a Payments or FinTech environment

  • Articulate and drive customer use cases, customer value and expansion while maintaining trusted customer advisor status

  • Drive overall account health including payments performance, cost optimization, product adoption, usage velocity, account renewals and growth, referrals, and customer satisfaction

 

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

  • 4+ years of experience in a client-facing role ideally customer success, managing relationships with large, global, and complex organizations, preferably working with a technical product
  • Sophisticated business sense and understanding of underlying drivers and strategy of our user’s businesses
  • Track record of leading technical conversations and persuading others to take action based on requirements and value provided by solutions
  • Strong analytical skills and operating rigor
  • Strong executive presence and presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders
  • History of success as a consultant, pre-sales, technical account management, or equivalent
  • Proven track record of achieving targets and goals, preferably in a sales setting
  • Track record of managing complex projects and/or programs

  • Must work within a team environment with sales and services peers

What you’ll do

We are hiring a senior editorial leader to help bring original stories and insights from Stripe–based on our data, expertise, and customer conversations–to a broader audience via media partnerships and other brand marketing channels. This person will be an exceptional editor, writer, and creative partner with strong instincts about what earns attention: an argument worth making, an unexpected angle, an elegant execution, or a piece of work that people genuinely want to share.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the leader of Stripe’s Narrative & Editorial team. The role will spend most of its time shaping major external media partnerships, with the remainder split between helping with original editorial work and advising partner teams on new ideas and their execution.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the editorial and creative direction for Stripe’s most important external media partnerships, including advertising content, research-led collaborations, and original editorial programs developed with respected publishers and creators.
  • Develop work that feels native to the audience and editorial environment in which it appears—not generic brand messaging placed beside someone else’s work.
  • Turn Stripe’s original data analyses, economic insights, customer stories, and more into content pieces that are clear, surprising, useful, and memorable–and that readers and listeners won’t want to skip over.
  • Shape the full editorial process for partnership work: refining briefs, identifying the strongest ideas, directing creative development, and providing decisive feedback on drafts and final deliverables.
  • Direct and manage agencies, external creators, and editorial partners as needed, working within existing partnership structures and commercial agreements.
  • Write, edit, and materially improve high-stakes content across formats, including blog posts, newsletter segments, podcast scripts, ad copy, social posts, and more.
  • Generate original concepts for creative programs, editorial franchises, and nontraditional formats that broaden how Stripe contributes to conversations about the internet economy.
  • Serve as a trusted thought partner to teams across Stripe, helping them clarify ideas, find the strongest expression of their work, and make better creative decisions.
  • Partner with colleagues in Brand Marketing, Brand Design, Content Marketing, Portfolio PMM, Copywriting, and Customer Marketing to make Stripe’s storytelling more coherent and distinctive.
  • Define and uphold a clear quality bar for editorial and partnership work, making well-reasoned calls about what is ready to represent Stripe and what still needs improvement.

Who you are

We are looking for someone with exceptional editorial judgment and a demonstrated ability to make complicated ideas compelling. You may have developed that experience in a newsroom, independent publication, creative studio, agency, research institution, technology company, or another rigorous creative environment.

  • You have 8+ years of relevant experience in editorial, writing, creative development, journalism, publishing, media, brand strategy, or a closely related field. This may include experience writing consistently for a large online followership, even if not professionally.
  • You have an exceptional portfolio of published or public-facing work that demonstrates strong writing and editing, original thinking, and an ability to make ideas resonate with an audience.
  • You are, in the best sense, very online: an active reader of and contributor to the newsletters, social platforms, and niche communities where people debate new ideas about technology, economics, science, business, and culture. You can spot emerging arguments, voices, and formats early—and engage with them authentically, with intellectual honesty and your own point of view.
  • You are an excellent editor. You can diagnose what is missing from a draft or idea, identify the most interesting argument, and give feedback that makes the work materially better.
  • You have experience developing original editorial work, sponsored media, advertising, creative partnerships, or other high-quality audience-facing programs.
  • You understand the difference between work that is merely on-message and work that is genuinely interesting, useful, or worth discussing.
  • You can translate complex subjects—including technology, business, economics, science, or policy—into work that is accessible without becoming simplistic.

  • You are deeply curious about the technology industry and the broader cultural and economic context in which it operates.
  • You are comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, external partners, writers, designers, marketers, and agencies without relying on formal authority.
  • You can move fluidly between strategy and execution: developing the core idea, shaping the brief, improving the draft, and making the final call on quality.
  • You have high standards, sound judgment, and enough pragmatism to help teams make excellent work within real constraints.

These partnerships create new routes to customers, extend the reach of Stripe’s Sales teams, and help Stripe and its partners serve shared customers.

The role sits on the Americas Alliances and Channels Tech Partnerships team. The team builds and executes joint go-to-market initiatives with major technology companies, with the goal of accelerating Stripe’s commercial growth.

As part of this team, you’ll lead global partnerships across the artificial intelligence ecosystem, with an initial emphasis on leading AI labs. You’ll work across Sales, Marketing, Product, Solutions Architecture, and regional partnerships teams to develop shared opportunities and turn them into scalable global partner strategies.

As a Partner Development Manager, you’ll define and build Stripe’s global partnerships across the artificial intelligence ecosystem, initially focusing on leading AI labs. Although the role sits on the Americas Alliances and Channels Tech Partnerships team, its mandate is global. You’ll establish relationships across partner organizations, develop shared value propositions, and translate early opportunities into joint commercial and product initiatives.

This is an opportunity to build a new partnership motion from the ground up. You’ll start with focused opportunities, determine what works, and create a playbook that Stripe’s regional teams can apply around the world. Your work will span co-selling, co-marketing, and co-building.

Responsibilities

  • Build senior relationships across the commercial, partnerships, product, and technical organizations of Stripe’s priority AI partners
  • Develop and execute global partner strategies, including shared value propositions, joint business plans, success measures, and operating cadences
  • Identify and launch co-selling, co-marketing, and co-building initiatives that create value for Stripe, its partners, and shared customers
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams across Sales, Marketing, Product, Solutions Architecture, Legal, Finance, and regional partnerships
  • Work with Product and technical teams to identify opportunities for product collaboration and support productive technical conversations with partners
  • Create repeatable partnership playbooks that regional teams can adapt for local markets and AI ecosystems
  • Assess partnership performance, identify opportunities and risks, and communicate progress clearly to senior stakeholders

  • Experience building a strategic technology partnership from its early stages and translating the relationship into joint commercial, go-to-market, or product outcomes
  • Experience developing and executing joint go-to-market plans with external partners and cross-functional Sales, Marketing, Product, or technical teams
  • Experience building relationships with senior external stakeholders and leading global or distributed teams through influence
  • Bachelor’s degree and willingness to travel

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience managing partnerships with artificial intelligence companies, cloud providers, data platforms, developer platforms, or other global technology ecosystems
  • Understanding of the artificial intelligence and data value chain, including the commercial and technical considerations involved in building partner ecosystems
  • Experience across co-selling, co-marketing, and product or technical collaboration
  • Experience developing a partnership framework or playbook that was adopted across multiple regions or teams
  • Experience in payments, financial infrastructure, financial services, or commerce

jobs.title: Partner Development Manager, Ecosystem Partnerships
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. About the team

Stripe’s Ecosystem Partnerships team builds the partner ecosystem that helps users discover, adopt, and get more value from Stripe. We work with a broad range of technology, platform, and ecosystem partners, and collaborate closely with Partner Engineering, Product Marketing, Product, Engineering, and go-to-market teams to bring Stripe’s products to market through partners.

What you’ll do

As a Partner Development Manager, you will own the day-to-day management and growth of a broad portfolio of ecosystem partners. You will contribute to the design and implementation of scalable partner programs and own the engagement, enablement, and operating rhythms that help partners succeed across your portfolio.

You will independently identify and drive growth opportunities, connecting partner goals with Stripe’s product and business priorities. You will lead initiatives that help partners adopt new Stripe platform building blocks, product capabilities, and integrations, define the cross-functional workstreams needed to deliver them, and measure their impact.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines partner and domain expertise with strong execution. You will lead partner planning and commercial discussions, translate market and partner insights into actionable recommendations, and bring the right stakeholders together to deliver measurable results at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Own day-to-day partnerships and distribution activities across a broad portfolio of ecosystem partners, using scalable programs, tiers, communications, and engagement models to expand partner impact; contribute to program design, criteria, partner lifecycle activities, and improvements informed by partner goals and performance
  • Lead partner roadmap, goal, success-metric, and delivery discussions; work with PE&O and RPS to develop account plans, run business reviews, track partner health, map executive relationships, build partner advocacy, and address operational, risk, and compliance matters through the appropriate operating model
  • Independently identify and pursue partner expansions, product enhancements, and distribution opportunities; engage the appropriate partners and internal stakeholders, define workstreams, and drive delivery within your partner, product, or program scope
  • Drive adoption of new Stripe platform building blocks and product capabilities through enablement, education, and launches; work with Partner Engineering on integration needs, recurring friction, shared delivery plans, and blockers, and with Product Marketing on messaging and campaigns; jointly set and analyze pipeline, activation, and adoption metrics
  • Align Product, Engineering, go-to-market teams, Operations, PE&O, RPS, and other stakeholders on responsibilities, milestones, and feedback channels; incorporate their input into planning, identify cross-functional gaps, communicate material developments, and seek manager support when alignment or escalation requires it
  • Serve as the primary negotiation lead for your partners, independently closing deals and renewals within established Stripe strategies and frameworks; balance timelines, economics, and product capabilities, improve deal execution, and escalate material deviations or blockers
  • Build and share deep partner, product, and market expertise; assess how partner changes affect Stripe’s users, products, financial outcomes, and operations, recommend responses, improve team practices, support colleagues’ development, and contribute to recruiting and an inclusive team culture

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management, or a comparable cross-functional role, with demonstrated ownership of external relationships and measurable business outcomes; experience managing a broad portfolio through scalable programs, engagement models, partner lifecycle activities, or enablement, and contributing to program improvements
  • 3+ years demonstrated ability to independently identify and evaluate growth opportunities, define workstreams, and drive initiatives through delivery; sound operational judgment in managing multiple workstreams, identifying risks and blockers, and seeking support when decisions extend beyond your scope
  • Experience leading partner planning, roadmap and success-metric discussions, and business reviews, with the analytical skills to assess partner health, pipeline, activation, adoption, or other relevant measures; ability to build deep partner and domain expertise and translate market or partner changes into actionable recommendations
  • Experience serving as a primary negotiation lead and closing commercial agreements within established strategies and frameworks, balancing economics, timelines, and product capabilities, and escalating material trade-offs appropriately
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and written and verbal communication skills, including aligning stakeholders on responsibilities and commitments, articulating product value, building partner advocacy, synthesizing complex feedback, and communicating material developments; interest in Stripe’s products, users, and ecosystem

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with ecosystem, platform, technology, payments, financial services, or software-as-a-service partnerships
  • Experience driving adoption of new product capabilities, integrations, or platform building blocks through partner enablement, education, or go-to-market programs
  • Experience working closely with partner-facing engineering, product, or product marketing teams on partner launches, integration improvements, or distribution initiatives
  • Experience improving partner program criteria, engagement models, commercial processes, or operating rhythms based on performance data and partner feedback
  • Familiarity with partner operations and risk and compliance considerations in a regulated or complex environment

The Financial Partnerships team sits within the Global Partnerships organization and is a key component of our success. Our team is responsible for developing and managing relationships with the global and regional banks that enable the Stripe product strategy and deliver new capabilities to Stripe users. Note: This is not a commercial sales position - for those opportunities, see our Business Development roles

What you'll do

We're looking for a Partner Development Manager to help manage out portfolio of international banks. You'll be responsible for developing and executing the multi-year, global strategies for building our relationships across many of our most important banking partners. You'll focus on designing, scaling, and continuously improving mechanisms to deepen relationships with our partners, as well as highly impactful programs key to differentiating Stripe. As part of these efforts, you'll collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders (including Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Risk, etc.), and with the banking partners' executive teams.

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated ability to manage and develop partners, think strategically and apply diagnostic thinking to business, product, and technical challenges, and earn trust with and influence others. A high-agency attitude, the ability to raise expectations in changing environments, and a drive to create impact through ownership are all important in this role.

Responsibilities

  • Develop the go-to-partner strategy and execute on our most ambitious company-bending, bank-network-driven projects that are global and cross-border in nature
  • Own the banking partner plans, the overall economics, day-to-day operational excellence, and be responsible for driving the partnerships to successful outcomes for Stripe
  • Leverage banking, treasury, and payments industry knowledge to craft thoughtful partnership and product strategies with transaction banks, lenders, capital markets, central banks, and schemes
  • Navigate, in partnership with Product, to execute deals supporting that strategy and help ensure a proper execution plan is in place
  • Leverage significant industry experience to educate and help internal teams compose our holistic bank-led strategy and to advance that strategy with banking partners

Who you are

Minimum requirements

  • 9+ years of relevant experience in banking or fintech, including direct ownership of banking partnerships supporting collections, payouts, stored value, or embedded financial products. This is a specialised banking-infrastructure partnerships role, rather than a general fintech business-development role. The strongest candidates will combine commercial bank-partner ownership with evidence that they have taken a payments capability into production.
  • Advanced knowledge of the banking and clearing landscape across multiple geographies with specific focus on transaction banking, e-money, safeguarding, multi-currency, and cross-border payments
  • Demonstrated experience building proprietary global collection and payout networks
  • A proven track record of working in a product-centric environment with significant internal and external dependencies across product, engineering, legal, sales, risk, and compliance
  • Broad and deep experience executing industry-wide partnership strategies to build innovative product experiences and go-to-market models

The Link Partnerships team sources, develops, and manages relationships with the payments ecosystem partners that power Link, Stripe's consumer wallet. Our team drives the growth and utility of Link by building partnerships with card networks, card issuers, local payment methods, crypto providers, and emerging commerce platforms. We execute on high-impact, cross-functional initiatives that expand Link's acceptance, improve performance, and enable new payment experiences—including agentic commerce. These partnerships have a significant impact on Stripe and the products used by millions of our users.

What you’ll do

We're looking for a Partner Development Manager who builds and manages Link's payments partnerships with card networks, card issuers, local payment method providers, and crypto and stablecoin providers. You'll own the strategy and execution of partnerships that expand Link's payment capabilities, improve transaction performance, and position Link as the default payments layer for agentic commerce. You'll negotiate commercial agreements, drive technical integrations, and shape Link's payments roadmap in collaboration with these partners. As part of these efforts, you'll collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders, including Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Risk, and others. You'll also lead relationship management and partner closely with external partners' executive leadership.

Responsibilities

  • Define and execute Link's payments partnership strategy across card networks, card issuers, local payment methods, and crypto and stablecoins
  • Negotiate and manage commercial agreements with payment partners that expand Link's acceptance footprint, improve authorization rates, and unlock new payment capabilities
  • Develop a deep understanding of the card network and issuer landscape—including scheme rules, tokenization frameworks, authentication protocols, and competitive dynamics—to inform partnership strategy
  • Drive partnerships that enable Link to serve as the payments layer for agentic commerce, working with networks and issuers to establish rules, liability frameworks, and technical standards for agent-initiated transactions
  • Gather inputs from and coordinate with internal cross-functional stakeholders (including product, risk, compliance, engineering, and security) to drive creation and execution of partner strategy including our global LPM roadmap
  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to define requirements and shape Link's payments product roadmap based on partner capabilities and market opportunities
  • Identify partner stakeholders who will champion Stripe, educate them about Link's value proposition, and build alignment between Stripe and our partners' executive teams
  • Identify and effectively analyze new partnership opportunities, ultimately making recommendations to relevant decision makers and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Exhibit an operationally focused mindset, with an ability to lead teams through complex relationship management activities by setting a clear vision and running tight processes

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

You're a skilled dealmaker and a strategist by nature. You understand how to work closely with Product and Engineering teams and can formulate partner strategies that drive tangible and measurable results. You're energized by the intersection of payments infrastructure and emerging commerce models, and you see the opportunity to define how payments work in an agentic world.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, corporate development, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in or working closely with card networks, card issuers, digital wallets, or payments infrastructure providers
  • 3+ years of experience negotiating commercial deals with partners, including scaling such deals across multiple partners
  • Strong communication skills, in both verbal and written form, and ability to influence stakeholders across a wide variety of functions, including at executive levels
  • Technical acumen, especially an ability to understand product strategy and use this understanding to define requirements for scaling products through partnerships
  • Experience developing partnership strategies and identifying, sourcing, and analyzing new partnership opportunities in greenfield segments
  • Strong agency, can handle ambiguity in a fast-moving organization, and thrives on a high level of autonomy and responsibility

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with card scheme rules, tokenization (network tokens, device tokens), authentication frameworks (3DS, SCA), and issuer-side authorization optimization
  • Experience with emerging payment models such as agentic commerce, embedded payments, or programmable payment flows
  • Experience building a new partnership category or vertical from zero—defining the strategy, establishing first partnerships, and scaling the program

Our team is responsible for building and maintaining relationships with key partner banks to manage risk for Stripe’s business activities. These banking partnerships are essential to enable Stripe to accept and make payments, provide credit, move & store money and develop new products and solutions to meet our users’ needs. We work across a broad range of risk and compliance topics including; credit, fraud, regulatory, financial crime, reputational, product and operational risks.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a new team member to collaborate with key banking partners throughout the UK, Europe and Stripe’s global partner network. These partners will work with Stripe to develop and deliver solutions that will build our Global Payments and Treasury Network. This role will support Stripe's goals to enable users to send and receive payments domestically and internationally, store funds securely, earn yield on those funds, and enable multi-currency fund flows.

Risk management is essential for managing these relationships, and this role requires a broad understanding of risk disciplines across banking activities, including accepting and making payments, money storage & transmission, and multi-currency/cross border fund flow.

  • Oversee and maintain the health of relationships with key risk counterparts at partner banks
  • Develop and manage projects and initiatives that support strong partner relationships regarding risk
  • Deliver business and policy recommendations that inform our risk posture
  • Act as a representative and negotiator of our risk approach to banking partners
  • Enhance existing and develop new partner-facing risk management capabilities
  • Lead risk-related partnership and product discussions with banking partners to align on risk approaches and strategies
  • Identify and pursue business opportunities by creating innovative risk-aware solutions that expand our product and user base through banking partnership

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Demonstrated deep knowledge and experience of working with bank payment schemes and networks (e.g. FPS, BACs, SEPA, ACH and local equivalents)
  • A deep knowledge of risk and compliance issues.
  • Ability to represent Stripe on risk, compliance, and product issues with banking partners to maintain positive relationships.
  • Strong organizational, planning, and communication skills (written and verbal) to drive understanding, collaboration, and issue resolution.
  • Curiosity and a partnership mindset focused on improving processes and scaling solutions.
  • First-hand experience in risk management at a bank or fintech
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including navigating difficult situations, negotiating timelines, and influencing stakeholders across organizations and borders.
  • Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to thrive in uncertain and ambiguous environments.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience of financial crime programmes including; KYC/B, AML, Sanctions and Terrorist Financing, with a practical knowledge of the Bank Secrecy Act and Anti-Money Laundering regulations.
  • A deep understanding of domestic & international payment schemes (e.g. FPS, CHAPS, BACs, SEPA, ACH, Wire).

  • Market experience across UK & Europe, with an understanding of how current and future regulations will impact Stripe and it’s banking partners.
  • Experience of leveraging technology to support the development and embedment of scalable risk and operational processes.

About Us

At Stripe, we're building a financial system for the internet. We're hiring talented people like you to help us make this vision a reality.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Dubai, UAE

About the Team:

In this role, you will contribute to Cloudflare's revenue generation engine by delivering pipeline at scale to the Sales counterparts. You will do this through a maniacal focus on people, process, and tools. The Business Development organization is anchored in a culture focused on the development & training of its employees, incubating talent across the company, teamwork, and celebrating success. With flawless execution, we believe the Business Development organization will be a competitive differentiator for Cloudflare.

This is a great opportunity to be a member of our high performing Sales team at a hyper-growth technology company. The Business Development Representative (BDR) will:

  • Be the first point of contact for customers that need help finding solutions
  • Develop your customer centric sales skills to deliver a stellar customer experience
  • Learn Cloudflare’s products and services in detail

Similar to other roles that Cloudflare, this role has a tenure requirement of 18-24 months before you may be eligible to apply for another role within the company.

About the Role

Languages required: English

This is a great opportunity to be an early member of a high performing sales team at a fast growing technology company. We are looking for ownership-oriented team members with excellent communication skills and technical curiosity. As the Business Development Representative (BDR), you will: 

  • Create excellent customer experiences
  • Learn customer-centric sales skills
  • Become an expert in Cloudflare’s product
  • Team members have opportunities to move into roles across the organization, especially in mid-market sales, customer success, solutions engineering, and sales operations

Day in the Life of BDR at Cloudflare

  • Own and meet target quota related to number of qualified opportunities, response SLA, value of sales pipeline, and revenue
  • Develop new business opportunities from inbound and marketing-generated leads
  • Discover pain points and use case, map them to broad set of Cloudflare solutions and qualify for Enterprise sales opportunities
  • Work cross-functionally with stakeholders (account executives, marketing, sales operations, fellow BDRs)
  • Report, track, and manage sales activities and results using SFDC
  • Play an active role in the creation and iteration of team processes

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

  • 2+ years of experience working as a BDR in a similar capacity in technology industry in the Africa & South Africa region (experience in SaaS will be a plus)
  • Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit
  • Ability to work as part of a team or independently
  • Analytical, organization and time management skills
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills
  • Customer-oriented mindset with empathy and curiosity
  • Aptitude to learn technical concepts/terms
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks/projects simultaneously
  • Experience in Outreach and Salesforce is a plus

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

  • Experience working with senior-level executives within partner organizations to align on business objectives and drive results.

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

In this high-impact, zero-to-one role, you will define and execute our strategy to transform Cloudflare’s rich network and CDN data into actionable business, marketing, and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) intelligence.

What you'll do

You will act as the crucial bridge between enterprise customers, Product & Engineering, and Go-To-Market (GTM) teams. Your mission is to build and commercialize the "Analytics of the Agentic Era"—helping non-technical business leaders, CMOs, and digital publishers measure content value, track agentic traffic, and optimize brand visibility across AI answer engines.

Responsibilities

1. Product Influence & Analytics Suite Definition

  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to translate raw CDN, bot, and network traffic signals into executive-ready dashboards and commercial analytics products.
  • Help design first-party analytics tools tailored for business personas—focusing on metrics like scraping-to-referral ratios, prompt library integrations, LLM brand presence, and content gap analysis.
  • Run design partner programs with top enterprise customers and media brands to gather feedback, validate feature roadmaps, and co-develop analytics prototypes.

2. GTM Strategy & Sales Enablement

  • Collaborate with Cloudflare’s Enterprise Sales and GTM teams to package, price, and position the Advanced Analytics Suite for commercial buyers.
  • Create sales playbooks, value frameworks, and pitch materials that translate complex technical infrastructure data into compelling business stories for non-technical buyers.
  • Serve as a domain expert in high-stakes customer meetings, executive briefing centers (EBCs), and pilot programs.

3. Expanding the Buyer Horizon Beyond CISOs

  • Champion Cloudflare’s strategic positioning beyond security (CISOs) and infrastructure (CTOs), actively expanding our mindshare among CMOs, digital strategists, and commercial leaders.
  • Educate external stakeholders on critical concepts in the agentic web, such as Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and synthetic web traffic attribution.

4. Ecosystem & Strategic Alliances

  • Identify, evaluate, and structure strategic partnerships with adjacent players in the marketing tech and AI ecosystem (e.g., AEO measurement platforms, attribution providers, AI ad networks, and commercial data platforms).
  • Leverage ecosystem relationships to enrich Cloudflare’s analytics capabilities and build joint go-to-market motions.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Strong experience orchestrating alignment across engineering, product management, sales, legal, and executive leadership teams.
  • Location: Based in or willing to work hybrid from our San Francisco, CA or New York, NY or Austin, TX offices.

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Singapore, or Sydney, Australia

About the Department

The Technical Account Team plays a crucial role in ensuring a seamless experience for Cloudflare users, ranging from individual developers to Fortune 500 enterprises. By providing expert technical guidance, proactive support, and complex issue resolution across multiple channels, the team enhances customer satisfaction, strengthens customer trust, and drives product improvement.

At Cloudflare, Technical Account Managers serve as trusted advisors to our top Enterprise customers. TAMs deliver high-touch technical guidance, customer advocacy, and operational support across the customer lifecycle. Acting as the eyes and ears of the company, TAMs capture valuable customer insights and work closely with internal teams to influence service enhancements and future product development.

What You'll Do

As a Technical Account Manager, you will own the post-sales technical support experience for Cloudflare's largest Enterprise customers across the Asia-Pacific & Japan (APJC) region, based in Singapore or Sydney. You will serve as the primary technical point of contact for assigned customers, helping them operate Cloudflare solutions successfully, resolve complex issues, and continuously improve the security, reliability, and performance of their environments.

You will act as an architectural governance partner, continuously mapping customer environments against industry best practices and Cloudflare's Well-Architected framework. By proactively identifying security gaps, single points of failure, configuration drift, and performance bottlenecks, you will help prevent incidents before they impact production. Working closely with Customer Success, Account Teams, Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Partners, and Customer Support, you will align technical solutions with customer roadmaps and business objectives. This role requires a strong mix of technical expertise, customer service excellence, executive communication, and strategic problem-solving to ensure high customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

  • Communicate effectively in English with enterprise customers and stakeholders across the APJC region.
  • Collaborate in English with global Product, Engineering, Support, Customer Success, Account Teams, Professional Services, and Partners.
  • Own and drive the post-sales technical support experience, ensuring timely, high-quality support outcomes.
  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues across Cloudflare products and customer environments.
  • Manage support interactions, drive escalations, coordinate internal response, and ensure clear customer communication during incidents.
  • Provide clear written and verbal updates, including technical recommendations, incident summaries, escalation updates, RCA follow-ups, and post-incident reports.
  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of customer environments, architectures, and Cloudflare deployments to support proactive issue resolution and long-term optimization.
  • Develop and maintain a rolling Technical Risk & Gap Register for each enterprise account, tracking architectural drift, legacy configurations, operational risks, and emerging security threats.
  • Prioritize remediation plans with customer stakeholders and help customers align their environments with security, reliability, and performance best practices.
  • Conduct Quarterly Support Reviews, including SLA adherence, incident reviews, ticket trend analysis, top support drivers, resilience planning, capacity planning, and proactive feature adoption.
  • Partner with the account team to support strategic customer engagements, including technical planning, roadmap alignment, renewal support, and incident response.
  • Provide actionable customer feedback to Product and Engineering teams to help shape product improvements.
  • Partner with Cloudflare's Threat Intelligence and Product teams to proactively evaluate customer environments against newly discovered vulnerabilities, zero-days, and emerging DDoS vectors.
  • Ensure defensive configurations and recommended mitigations are deployed ahead of potential exploits where appropriate.
  • Establish continuous drift-detection workflows to ensure customer configurations do not deviate from established security baselines, compliance standards, or optimal performance thresholds.
  • Leverage AI-driven tools and workflows to optimize daily operations, including incident summarization, case prioritization, support trend analysis, and automated handover documentation.
  • Utilize AI-powered analytics to conduct proactive configuration health checks and architectural reviews, identifying systemic risks and strategic infrastructure optimization opportunities.
  • Streamline the creation of technical documentation, including HLDs, LLDs, technical recommendations, customer-facing summaries, and post-incident reports.
  • Deploy AI-assisted incident management workflows to improve communication precision, including impact assessment, automated status updates, and rapid synthesis of complex technical event details.
  • Act as a point of escalation during APJC business hours and provide backup support for global TAMs in other time zones when required.
  • Work one weekend per month as part of the TAM coverage model.
  • Travel up to 25% of the time to support customer engagements across the region.

What We're Looking For

We are seeking a highly motivated, customer-focused technical expert who can combine deep technical knowledge with strong customer advocacy, communication, and business judgment.

Technical Expertise

  • Strong understanding of networking concepts, including Layer 7 technologies and routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, IPSec, and GRE.
  • Experience with security technologies, including Firewalls, IPS, DDoS mitigation, WAF, and application security controls.
  • Experience with cloud, SaaS, CDN, edge networking, or security platforms.
  • Knowledge of system integration, multi-vendor environments, and data center deployments.
  • Proficiency with diagnostic and troubleshooting tools, including traceroute, Wireshark, dig, cURL, logs, packet captures, and browser developer tools.
  • Familiarity with the OSI Model, proxies, HTTP, DNS, TLS/SSL, application security, and network security.
  • Ability to analyze complex technical issues, identify root causes, and provide practical remediation guidance.
  • Passion for Cloudflare's products and a strong desire to help customers succeed.

Customer & Business Acumen

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a customer-facing technical support, technical account management, solutions engineering, customer success engineering, or account management role.
  • Proven ability to work with Enterprise and Fortune 500 customers.
  • Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong customer-facing written communication skills, including the ability to produce incident summaries, technical recommendations, executive updates, and post-incident follow-ups.
  • Ability to manage multiple customer priorities, escalations, and internal workstreams at the same time.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-moving environment.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Strong ownership mindset, customer empathy, and commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes.

Why This Role Matters

This role is an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of Cloudflare's Enterprise customer experience across the Asia-Pacific & Japan (APJC) region. As a Technical Account Manager, you will help some of the region's most important businesses improve their network performance, security posture, resilience, and operational maturity while directly influencing the future of Cloudflare's products and services.

The Opportunity:

We’re looking for a Strategic Partnerships Lead to own multi-threaded strategic partnerships and carry those negotiations from structuring through signature and into the field. This is a senior individual contributor role. It is not a program role.

You will work with two kinds of partners: Large, publicly traded ISVs, where one relationship covers the product integration, the commercial agreement, and how both field teams take it to customers. And developer and infrastructure platforms, where you will expand our one-click motion: a customer clicks “Monitor with Grafana Cloud” in the partner product, we create or attach a Grafana Cloud account, and telemetry, dashboards, and alerting are provisioned without a manual setup.

You will recruit partners, work closely  with Product and Engineering teams on what gets built, negotiate the terms that make the integration hold, and work with Sales so the partnership shows up in real pursuits. 

This role reports to the Senior Director, Corporate Business Development.

What You’ll Be Doing:

- Own the plan for each partner, including which opportunities to pursue and which to pass on

- Scope product integrations with Product and Engineering, including one-click provisioning into Grafana Cloud, the telemetry and dashboards that come with them, and where Grafana shows up inside the partner product

- Lead negotiations through signature, covering revenue share, attribution, placement, co-sell, data and brand terms, and term length

- Run integration, commercial, and field workstreams together on large ISV partnerships, so a term in one workstream still works in the others

- Expand the “one-click” motion to additional partners, and structure the economics around the product surfaces that drive conversion

- Launch partnerships with the field, including enablement, account mapping, and a path for sellers to use the integration in a pursuit

- Coordinate Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Legal from the first structuring conversation through launch

What Makes You a Great Fit:

- You have owned technology partnerships end to end, including the negotiation, with more than one live workstream in the same account

- You have closed integration partnerships that Product and Engineering had to build, and the commercial terms held after signature

- You have taken a partnership into the field, including the launch and seller enablement

- You are comfortable running several significant negotiations at the same time

- You work across Product, Engineering, Sales, Legal, and Finance without needing a team under you

- 8-10+ years in strategic business development, product partnerships, or technology alliances

Bonus Points For:

- Partnerships in developer tools, infrastructure, observability, or API platforms

- Experience with large, publicly traded ISVs, including who owns the roadmap and who owns the field

- In-product distribution: placement, provisioning or marketplace motions, and revenue share tied to conversion

- Enough technical fluency to work with engineers on APIs, telemetry, and account provisioning

- Structuring experience in corporate development, strategy, legal, or finance

Partnerships Manager – Strategic & Growth

We are looking for a commercially driven Partnerships Manager to build and activate strategic partnerships that generate net-new business pipeline and help win high-value enterprise customers.

The role will focus on creating opportunities through partners, developing partner champions, supporting enterprise deals and competitor displacement, and turning the partner ecosystem into a meaningful growth channel.

You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Solutions Consulting, and Product teams. You will not own the sales close; your role is to create the relationships, introductions, influence, and opportunities that help Sales win.

Success will be measured by commercial impact, including:

  • Net-new leads and qualified opportunities sourced through partners.
  • Enterprise pipeline and ACV influenced by partnerships.

  • Number and quality of active partner champions.
  • Growth and productivity of priority partnerships.

The goal is not to have the most partners but it is to have the right partners generating meaningful business impact.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS, technology partnerships, business development, or channel sales.
  • Proven ability to build partnerships that generate new business and pipeline.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise sales and complex stakeholder environments.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASELAYER

Every business in America needs a bank account to exist. The system that decides whether they're real, who's behind them, and whether they're a risk, runs on infrastructure from the 1980s. We're rebuilding that layer from scratch.

Baselayer is the identity layer for institutions across the United States: the most complete business graph in America and every human tied to it. We fuse public records, IRS data, sanctions lists, web signals, and fraud telemetry from 2,200+ financial institutions into a single graph that resolves any business and the humans behind it in milliseconds. The legacy credit bureaus took 50 years to build something that gets 60% match rates. We've built something that gets 98% in under two years.

Today we're trusted by over 20% of financial institutions in America including FIS, Rho, Socure and top five US banks. But the graph is becoming infrastructure for anyone who needs to know if a business is real and worth trusting: gig platforms, marketplaces, AI companies, and commerce infrastructure at scale.

Trust is the substrate of every financial transaction. We're rebuilding it.

ABOUT THE TEAM

AI agents are starting to transact: opening accounts, buying services, moving money on behalf of the businesses and people behind them. Every one of those transactions has a counterparty asking the question banks have always asked: who am I dealing with, and can I trust them? Today's identity infrastructure wasn't built to answer it at agent speed.

The Agentic Economy team is extending Baselayer's business graph into the trust layer for agentic commerce: verifiable credentials that bind an agent to the verified business and human behind it, a registry counterparties can query in real time, and verification APIs that plug into the networks, platforms, and protocols where agent transactions happen.

jobs.description:
AssetWatch serves global manufacturers by powering manufacturing uptime through the delivery of an unparalleled condition monitoring experience, with a passion to care about the assets our customers care for every day. We are a devoted and capable team that includes world-renowned engineers and distinguished business leaders united by a common goal – To build the future of predictive maintenance. As we enter the next phase of rapid growth, we are seeking people to help lead the journey. 

At AssetWatch, we are committed to maximizing manufacturing uptime by delivering a proactive condition monitoring experience. Our team of experts shares a common goal: to be the world's leading condition monitoring platform, helping manufacturers eliminate unplanned downtime worldwide. 

Position Overview 

The Vice President of Customer Success is a senior executive leader who owns the commercial performance of AssetWatch's installed customer base, maximizing long-term customer value through world-class adoption, retention, expansion, and operational excellence. This position plays a critical role in shaping AssetWatch's post-sale strategy and market position, with direct accountability for customer outcomes, team performance, and enterprise-wide customer-centric initiatives.  

The Vice President of Customer Success is expected to build a world-class Customer Success organization capable of supporting a business scaling to $200M+ ARR while maintaining industry-leading retention and customer satisfaction and is responsible to lead a team across multiple levels and regions, ensuring consistent delivery of world-class service, driving product adoption, and embedding AI-powered solutions and best practices throughout the organization.

Strategic Vision and Organizational Leadership 

  • Develop and execute customer success strategy aligned with revenue targets and product roadmap.

jobs.title: Account Manager (NitraMart)
jobs.description: Who we are: Nitra's mission is to build a more efficient healthcare system and the technology that makes it possible. Our goal is to provide an ecosystem of fintech and software solutions that help doctors better manage their practices, so they can have time back to focus on what matters to them most. We operate with urgency, intensity, and ambition. The bar is high because the opportunity is massive. We expect excellence, ownership, and intellectual rigor from every team member. We move fast, make bold decisions, and hold ourselves accountable to results. At the same time, we believe great companies are built on trust and respect. Every voice matters. Every contribution counts. When we win, we win together. We are scaling rapidly and on a clear trajectory toward becoming a unicorn this year — and beyond. Our growth is not accidental; it’s the result of disciplined execution, relentless focus, and a team that refuses to settle. We are building a category-defining company, and we’re looking for people who want to do the most meaningful work of their careers. If you want comfort, this isn’t the place. If you want impact, ownership, and the chance to help build a generational fintech company, welcome. Nitra was created by unicorn founders who have successfully scaled to thousands of customers and exited $1B+ public offerings. They are joined by an ambitious and experienced team from American Express, Citi, PayPal, Capsule, Plaid, Bloomberg, Meta, Facebook, and Mastercard. The team is backed by some of the world’s leading VCs (Andreessen Horowitz, NEA, etc.) and is supported by an expert group of advisors including the cofounders of Square and Xendit, executives from Intuit, former Governors, White House senior staffers, and a co-founder of CityMD. Nitra maintains a hybrid work policy, with team members working from the office four days per week and Wednesdays designated as a work-from-home day. We're looking for: An experienced Account Manager to manage and grow a book of business within Nitramart, Nitra’s healthcare marketplace. This role is focused on customer retention, revenue growth, cross-selling, and upselling within a B2B healthcare supply environment. The ideal candidate has 2–4+ years of experience in medical B2B sales or account management, particularly selling medical supplies, healthcare products, or related services. You should be comfortable managing a substantial portfolio of accounts and proactively identifying expansion opportunities. This is a commercially driven role with direct accountability to revenue performance — not a customer support position.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager (AI Driven) - Curveglass
jobs.description: Curveglass is a startup incubated by AE Studio that provides a flight-level correction layer for airline revenue management, helping airlines make better decisions through advanced data science and modeling. As part of the AE Studio ecosystem, Curveglass combines the speed, focus, and ownership of a startup with access to a broader network of engineering, AI, and product expertise. Curveglass runs directly inside each airline's cloud environment. Our product consists of a common Core and a client-specific Adapter , which handles everything needed to make Curveglass work within each airline's environment — including the web application, APIs, data integrations, business rules, and exports into the airline's systems. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Technical Account Manager at Curveglass, you'll own the technical implementation of Curveglass for airline clients end-to-end. This is a hands-on engineering role with broad ownership. You'll build and maintain client-specific Adapter code, work across frontend and backend systems, integrate with airline data and infrastructure, and deploy and operate Curveglass within client cloud environments. You'll also work directly with clients. That means understanding their technical and business needs, participating in and leading meetings, troubleshooting issues, analyzing recommendation results in collaboration with revenue management teams, and managing technical expectations as needed. You'll work closely with the Curveglass core team to determine what should be solved within a client's Adapter and what should become part of the shared Core. You'll bring client needs back to the team as roadmap input and Core change requests, while owning the implementation of client-specific functionality yourself. We're looking for someone who enjoys the full lifecycle of software engineering: understanding the problem, building the solution, deploying it, and seeing how it performs in the real world. You'll have meaningful ownership over the systems you build and the opportunity to influence Curveglass's architecture and product as we grow. If you enjoy owning technical problems end-to-end and working closely with the people using what you build, we'd love to talk. ABOUT YOU You're a strong, pragmatic engineer who enjoys owning systems beyond just writing the code. You're comfortable working across different parts of the stack and taking responsibility for an implementation from beginning to end: understanding requirements, designing the solution, building integrations and product functionality, deploying infrastructure, troubleshooting issues, and continuing to improve the system once it's live. You're comfortable operating in a startup environment where problems may not always come neatly defined. You can take ownership, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and move from an ambiguous problem to a reliable production solution. You also communicate well with people outside of engineering. You can understand the business context behind a technical request, explain technical decisions clearly, and lead conversations with clients when needed. You work well independently, collaborate closely with data science and product teams, and care about building software that is reliable, maintainable, and genuinely useful. Required Skills and Experience Strong software engineering experience: You can independently design, build, debug, and maintain production systems. Fluency in Python: You're highly proficient with Python and comfortable using it in production environments. Full-stack development: You're comfortable working with TypeScript and React and can own frontend functionality when needed. SQL and data integration: You can work confidently with relational data, APIs, client datasets, and production data flows. Cloud infrastructure: You're comfortable deploying and maintaining applications in AWS or Azure. Containers and infrastructure as code: You have hands-on experience with containers and tools such as Terraform. End-to-end ownership: You're comfortable taking responsibility for a system across application code, integrations, infrastructure, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. Client-facing communication: You're comfortable interacting directly with clients, leading technical meetings when needed, explaining decisions clearly, managing expectations, and pushing back thoughtfully when appropriate. Business thinking: You care about why something is being built and the outcome it needs to create, not just the technical implementation. Production-minded development: You write maintainable code and care about reliability, observability, debugging, and how systems behave in real-world environments. AI-powered development: You use modern AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow and know how to use them effectively without sacrificing quality. Self-management: You can take ownership of complex problems, navigate ambiguity, and deliver without constant oversight. Effective communication in English: You're fluent in spoken and written English and can confidently communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Timezone flexibility: You're comfortable occasionally adapting meeting hours to work with clients across the Americas, Europe, and the Middle East. Bonus Points for Enterprise implementation experience: You've implemented enterprise or data products where customers require meaningful integration and customization rather than a purely self-service SaaS product. Airline or revenue management experience: Familiarity with airline pricing, forecasting, revenue management, or related systems. Data engineering experience: You've worked with production data pipelines and technologies such as Parquet, Snowflake, or similar data infrastructure. Spanish or Portuguese: Professional proficiency in either language. Startup experience: You thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy ambiguity, and are comfortable taking ownership beyond a narrowly defined job description. Cloud deployment experience: You've deployed and operated applications or infrastructure within enterprise AWS or Azure environments. Strong product instincts: You understand when something should be solved as client-specific functionality versus becoming part of a broader product. WHAT WE OFFER Startup environment, backed by AE Studio: Join a focused, fast-moving startup while benefiting from the broader engineering, AI, and product ecosystem of AE Studio. High-impact engineering: Build production systems that directly shape the Curveglass product and how airlines use it. End-to-end responsibility: Own your work from architecture and implementation through deployment, integration, and ongoing operation. Real-world problems: Work on complex engineering and data problems within airline revenue management, where the software you build directly supports business decisions. Direct product exposure: Work closely with the people using what you build and bring those insights back into technical and product decisions. Product influence: Help shape Curveglass's architecture, roadmap, and approach to client-specific versus shared product functionality. Small, collaborative team: Work closely with engineering, data science, product, and leadership, with significant autonomy over how you solve problems. Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere, or connect with the broader AE Studio team and community. Flexible schedules: We care about outcomes, ownership, and impact—not micromanagement. Competitive compensation: Competitive pay and the opportunity to grow alongside the company. Opportunities for growth: Help shape how Curveglass approaches engineering, infrastructure, integrations, and technical decision-making as we scale.

jobs.title: Business Development Lead
jobs.description: About Fin Fin is a next-generation payments platform built for high-value, global, and instant transactions. We are a Series A-stage company backed by Sequoia, Circle, and other notable investors. Powered by stablecoins, Fin enables users and businesses to move millions of dollars in seconds - whether to other Fin users, directly into bank accounts, or across crypto rails. By combining the speed of crypto with the reliability and trust of traditional finance, Fin reimagines how money moves worldwide. If banks and payment products were reinvented today, they would look like Fin. Qualifications 3–10+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, or revenue-focused roles in fintech, payments, SaaS, or banking. Excellent relationship-building and communication skills, with the ability to keep multiple stakeholders aligned and deals moving. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.
