As an innovator and leader in Network Detection and Response (NDR) and Network Performance Management (NPM), we help State, Local, and Education (SLED) institutions secure their transition to the "Agentic Enterprise" by defending against AI-powered threats, streamlining operations, and delivering full visibility across their network and AI estate. We turn wire data into "Decision-Grade Intelligence"—the high-fidelity context that enables SOC and NOC teams to detect threats, optimize performance, investigate faster, and respond at machine speed. If you are an experienced sales professional who thrives in the security and networking markets and can help SLED customers navigate the transition toward an Agentic SOC and Agentic NOC, we want to hear from you. This key position requires an individual who can rapidly acquire and maintain in-depth knowledge of ExtraHop’s vision, products, technologies, competitive offerings, and prevailing industry trends relevant to the public sector. Your primary responsibility will be to significantly increase revenue across Central US SLED accounts by identifying, recruiting, and developing net-new opportunities with channel partners, SLED-focused resellers, and integrators. Key Responsibilities Consistently meet and exceed assigned sales targets by securing new SLED accounts (State Agencies, Local Government, K-12, and Higher Education) and expanding revenue within existing public sector customer installations. Proactively identify and qualify prospects through targeted outreach, lead follow-up, and in-person meetings with SLED decision-makers (e.g., State CIOs/CISOs, Network/IT Directors, University IT Leaders, Municipal Managers). Align with senior SLED executives to understand their mission-critical business requirements, decision-making processes, unique budget cycles, and funding mechanisms. Articulate how AI Modernization requires decision-grade intelligence to drive security and operational resilience across public sector networks. Help SLED customers transition from reactive, disconnected alerts to proactive, autonomous workflows within their SOC and NOC environments. Sell the platform's unique ability to provide comprehensive visibility and health monitoring across the entire AI and network estate, including traffic patterns and AI-model interactions. Demonstrate how ExtraHop serves as the foundational "source of truth" for packet-level insights, network performance, and threat intelligence for both human teams and autonomous AI agents. Identify opportunities to solve modern operational and security challenges, including network blind spots, AI-powered attacks, identity-based threats, and shadow AI usage. Prepare and rigorously implement strategic territory plans, leveraging key SLED contract vehicles and identifying business growth opportunities. Collaborate closely with SLED-focused resellers, system integrators, field sales engineers, and management throughout the sales cycle, including opportunity registration and accurate revenue forecasting. Required Qualifications Minimum of five years’ experience in technology sales with a consistent track record of exceeding quotas, including a minimum of three years dedicated specifically to SLED security and network solutions sales. Deep understanding of the modern SOC and NOC landscape, specifically the shift toward Agentic SOC/NOC workflows and runtime asset/network visibility. Proven ability to sell NDR, NPM, or complex network and security solutions that integrate across existing IT infrastructure. Ability to articulate the operational risks and performance impact associated with AI adoption, as well as the importance of network visibility across the AI estate. Demonstrated technical acumen to articulate ExtraHop's combined security and network performance value proposition in a differentiated and compelling manner to SLED audiences. Existing senior-level relationships across SLED accounts within the Central US territory. Exceptional communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills essential for navigating the SLED procurement landscape. Solid understanding of enterprise networking technologies (switches, routers, firewalls, load balancers, WAN optimization) as applied in SLED environments. Ability to travel up to 50% to support SLED customer engagements and regional public sector events. Ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-stress environments with predictable, reliable attendance. Compensation & Benefits: The salary range for this role is $145,000 – $157,000 per year, plus eligibility for sales commissions and stock option grants. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective Day 1), a 401(k) with employer match, flexible PTO, parental leave, and more. ABOUT EXTRAHOP ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments. This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise. jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Sales Field Operations, Americas
jobs.description: From Fivetran ’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. About the Role The Director of AMER Enterprise Sales Field Operations is the primary operations partner to the VP of AMER Enterprise Sales. You will own the operating rhythm of the region: forecasting, pipeline generation and inspection, and business reviews. You will also shape the region's go-to-market strategy, expansion plans, and capacity model. In this role, you will act as the COO to the VP of AMER Enterprise Sales, ensuring our business is growing efficiently and effectively. You need to think strategically about the Enterprise business, understanding the implications of changing market and team dynamics and proactively developing solutions that enable us to win. You will lead a team of three field operations managers and analysts. Success in this role means a more accurate forecast, a healthier pipeline, measurable gains in rep productivity, and increasing ARR across AMER Enterprise. The work you do will shape how Fivetran grows in the Americas. This role sits within the GTM Strategy and Operations organization. What You’ll Do Forecasting and pipeline Own the AMER Enterprise forecast process, including call methodology, roll-up, and accuracy tracking against commit and best case, giving leadership a number they can commit to with confidence. Drive pipeline generation planning: with the marketing, partner, and sales leadership teams set coverage targets by segment and source, track progress, and flag gaps early enough to act, so each quarter starts with the pipeline needed to hit plan. Run pipeline inspection with sales leadership, focusing on deal quality, stage progression, and slippage, so risk surfaces while there is still time to save the deal. Operating cadence and performance management Design and run the region's operating cadence: weekly forecast calls, pipeline reviews, monthly business reviews, and quarterly business reviews. Continuously refine those cadences so they drive decisions rather than reporting. Run AE performance reviews with frontline and second-line managers, using consistent metrics to identify coaching needs and performance risk, so managers act on facts rather than anecdotes. Identify and prioritize the metrics the field uses to run the business, and partner with GTM Analytics to build and maintain the supporting dashboards, giving every leader in the region a shared view of performance. Lead deep-dive investigations into performance questions, and turn findings into specific recommendations that change how the region sells. Regional strategy Shape GTM strategy and org structure for AMER Enterprise by region and sales motion, setting the team up to win as enterprise AI demand grows. Build the analysis behind regional expansion decisions, such as which territories to enter next and in what sequence, so we invest where the opportunity is largest. Design region- and motion-specific SPIFFs, then measure whether they changed behavior and results. Annual planning and capacity (in partnership with Strategy and Planning) Support quota setting for the region, bringing field context to top-down targets so quotas are both ambitious and attainable. Support and refine territory carving so territories are balanced and match the coverage model. Pressure-test assumptions in the bottoms-up headcount model and coverage ratios, so hiring plans reflect real field performance. Validate rep productivity and ramp assumptions against actual performance data. Team leadership Lead, hire, and develop a team of field operations managers and analysts and grow them into strategic partners to sales leadership. Set clear priorities for the team and allocate its capacity against the needs of AMER Enterprise leadership. Who you'll work with VP of AMER Enterprise Sales and their leadership team: your primary stakeholders and day-to-day partners. Strategy and Planning: annual plan, quota, territory, and capacity modeling. Revenue Operations: CRM, systems, process, and data integrity. GTM Analytics: dashboards, reporting, and analytical deep dives. Enablement: onboarding, ramp, and skill gaps surfaced through performance reviews. Skills We’re Looking For 8+ years in sales operations, sales strategy, management consulting, or a related analytical role, including 4+ years supporting enterprise sales teams directly. 4+ years managing people, ideally analysts or operations managers. Track record of owning a forecast process and improving its accuracy. Experience running sales operating cadences and business reviews with senior sales leaders. Working knowledge of annual planning: quota setting, territory design, capacity and coverage modeling, and ramp assumptions. Strong analytical skills, including building models in spreadsheets and working with CRM and BI data (for example, Salesforce, Tableau, Looker, or SQL). Ability to turn analysis into a clear recommendation and defend it with sales leaders. Bonus Skills​ Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with a consumption-based or usage-based pricing model. Experience designing sales incentive programs or SPIFFs. Experience supporting regional expansion or new-segment launches. Prior experience as the dedicated operations partner to a regional sales leader. Perks and Benefits 100% employer-paid medical insurance * Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. RSU stock grants* Professional development and training opportunities Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities Monthly cell phone stipend Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. * May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region. We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion , but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream . Read about us in Forbes . Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities. To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video. To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here . We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form . We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.

Whilst the individual can work remotely anywhere in Germany, the role will entail travel to customer sites across the region as required In this role, you will: Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices Minimum requirements for the role: 5+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in Enterprise level accounts, winning multiple $100k+ ARR transactions Proven expertise winning new business logos through a repeatable sales motion Demonstrable expertise in strategic outbound prospecting, particularly via inside sales Experience handling enterprise deal sizes with multiple stakeholders at C-Level Value based selling approach, leveraging Command of the Message, MEDDPICC or similar Excellent interpersonal skills, with demonstrated ability thriving in a dynamic, fast-paced environment Native-level German language skills An ideal candidate also has: SaaS sales experience Experience working with line of business stakeholders (Operations, Finance, IT) Comfortable in a dynamic, customer facing environment MEDDIC experience or similar (Sandler Pain Funnel, etc) Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways Highly collaborative with a growth mindset. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Accommodations Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. Our Commitment to Authenticity We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer (Colorado/Missouri)
jobs.description: Get to Know Us Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results. As a remote first company, we require minimum 25Mbps consumer grade broadband connection. About the Role Horizon3 is redefining how organizations defend themselves against modern cyber threats. Our autonomous security platform, NodeZero , helps companies proactively find and fix vulnerabilities before attackers do. We’re looking for a Sales Engineer (open to mid to senior level) to partner closely with our Account Executives and help growing organizations understand the technical and business value of our platform. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in high-velocity environments, can simplify complex security concepts, and enjoys building trusted relationships with customers. Location Requirement: Colorado or Kansas City, Missouri What You’ll Do Be a trusted technical partner in Mid-Enterprise or Enterprise deals Work alongside AEs to support discovery, solution positioning, and technical validation across mid-sized organizations with diverse environments. Lead discovery and technical qualification Meet with prospective customers to understand their infrastructure, security maturity, compliance requirements, and risk priorities. Deliver tailored demos and PoVs Run compelling, outcome-driven demos and proof-of-value engagements that clearly connect NodeZero’s capabilities to customer risk reduction and business impact. Maintain continuity through the customer lifecycle Stay connected with key accounts to track evolving needs, ensure continued value realization, and surface expansion opportunities where it makes sense to. Translate technical depth into business value Help customers understand not just how the platform works, but why it matters—framing results in terms of exposure reduction, compliance alignment, and operational efficiency. Own technical deal strategy Navigate objections, competitive positioning, and technical concerns throughout the sales cycle. Collaborate cross-functionally Partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Product Marketing to ensure field feedback informs roadmap and positioning. Support enablement and knowledge sharing Contribute to internal knowledge sharing and continuously refine demo flows, technical assets, and playbooks for the Mid-Market segment. Own post-close technical continuity Stay engaged after the deal closes to ensure a smooth technical handoff, reinforce initial value, and maintain executive and practitioner alignment—remaining attentive to adoption, impact, and expansion signals What You’ll Bring 5+ years of experience as a Sales Engineer or Solutions Architect, ideally in cybersecurity or infrastructure Located in SouthWest Region of the United States Experience working Mid-Market or Enterprise accounts with a mix of technical depth and executive interaction Strong understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals (threat landscape, vulnerability management, identity, cloud, AD, etc.) Ability to simplify complex technical concepts for both practitioners and executives Experience running structured PoVs and managing technical validation cycles Strong collaboration skills and comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity, or related field (or equivalent experience) What Success Looks Like You build strong, trust-based relationships with Mid-Market/Enterprise customers PoVs are structured, outcome-driven, and consistently demonstrate clear value You partner seamlessly with AEs and contribute meaningfully to pipeline progression and win rates Customer feedback informs ongoing product and positioning improvements Compensation and Values At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations. In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position: $240k - $270k OTE 70/30 Split annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills. Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options. Perks of Horizon3 Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive. Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities. Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking. Remote Work: We are a 100% remote company. Enjoy the flexibility to work in the way that supports you and brings out your best. Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave. You Belong Here Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law. Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless. Other Duties Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Application Note In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Sales Technology & AI Enablement
jobs.description: Reports to: VP, Sales Enablement About Axiom Axiom, a leading global marketplace for on-demand legal talent, is leading a revolution in the legal industry. The Axiom model disrupts the traditional allocation of work to law firms and in-house teams. By matching highly credentialed lawyers and legal talent with legal work across industries and practice areas, Axiom enables clients to become more agile and efficient and empowers lawyers and legal talent to pursue more of the work they love. Axiom serves over half the Fortune 100 with market leading NPS ratings from both its clients and employees. Position Summary The Senior Manager, Sales Technology & AI Enablement translates commercial technology, sales processes, AI-enabled workflows, and Axiom's AI-enabled client solutions into practical ways of working for sellers and managers. This role serves as the Enablement lead for the commercial technology ecosystem: helping the field use core sales technologies and AI to work more effectively, while partnering with Technology & Talent and AI Client Solutions leaders to build field readiness to position Axiom's evolving AI solutions. The role partners closely with Revenue Operations, GTM Transformation, IT, Marketing, Product, Technology & Talent, and sales leadership to ensure sellers and managers can leverage internal technology and AI effectively and confidently bring Axiom's AI-enabled solutions into client conversations. The role does not own enterprise system administration or design Axiom's client AI solutions. It owns the field activation layer: understanding the seller experience, translating technology, process, and solution capabilities into clear seller and manager behaviors, building the enablement experience, and measuring whether the field can use internal tools and position Axiom's AI-enabled solutions effectively. Key Responsibilities Commercial Technology and Workflow Expertise Serve as the Commercial Enablement subject matter expert for Gong, Salesforce, Clay, ChatGPT and other AI capabilities, sales engagement tools, and related commercial platforms, while building sufficient fluency in Axiom's AI-enabled client solutions to translate them effectively for the field. Develop a deep understanding of end-to-end seller and manager workflows, including prospecting and outreach channels, opportunity management, pipeline inspection, forecasting, and account planning. Understand Axiom's sales process, sales stages, required activities, data expectations, and handoffs well enough to translate system and process changes into clear field behavior. Stay current on platform capabilities, releases, integrations, emerging commercial AI use cases, and Axiom's evolving AI-enabled client solutions; identify opportunities to simplify internal work, improve seller productivity, and strengthen the field's ability to position relevant solutions with clients. Identify practical opportunities for sellers and managers to use generative AI and other AI-enabled capabilities to improve productivity, quality, and consistency across the sales workflow, including research, account planning, meeting preparation, outreach, opportunity management, follow-up, and manager coaching. Translate those opportunities into usable field practices, prompt guidance, examples, demonstrations, job aids, and reinforcement that help sellers apply AI effectively in the flow of work rather than treating AI as a stand-alone tool. Cross Functional Design and Influence Partner with Revenue Operations, GTM Transformation, IT, Marketing, Product, Technology & Talent, AI Client Solutions, and other functional teams early in the design or introduction of new tools, workflows, process changes, and AI-enabled client offerings that require field activation. Represent the seller and manager experience in technology and process decisions, influencing requirements, workflow design, launch sequencing, communications, and measures of success. Assess whether an initiative requires formal enablement, manager-led activation, targeted communications, performance support, or another adoption approach. Clarify ownership across system administration, process design, communications, enablement, and field reinforcement so launches are coordinated and sustainable. AI Solution Sales Enablement Partner with Technology & Talent and AI Client Solutions leaders to translate Axiom's AI-enabled offerings, use cases, and value propositions into practical field enablement for sellers and managers. Build seller readiness to recognize relevant client needs, conduct effective early-stage discovery, position Axiom's AI-enabled solutions, articulate business value, navigate common questions and objections, and engage the appropriate solution experts. Translate complex AI solution concepts into clear, commercially relevant messaging, talk tracks, playbooks, learning experiences, demonstrations, job aids, and manager reinforcement without requiring sellers to become technical AI experts. Create repeatable field guidance that clarifies what sellers should know and do at each stage of the commercial conversation, including when to bring in Technology & Talent or AI Client Solutions expertise. Maintain field readiness as Axiom's AI-enabled offerings and go-to-market approach evolve, using seller and manager feedback to identify knowledge gaps, improve enablement, and reinforce effective positioning. Enablement Design and Delivery Create activation plans that connect each technology, process, or AI-solution launch to the specific seller and manager knowledge, behaviors, and actions required for success. Build clear, engaging self-paced learning modules, live demonstrations, short instructional videos, job aids, workflow maps, step-by-step guides, FAQs, and manager discussion materials. Deliver live demonstrations and working sessions for leaders, managers, sellers, and cross-functional partners when direct instruction or practice is the right intervention. Design manager-first activation approaches that equip leaders to introduce changes, reinforce expectations, coach application, and address adoption barriers with their teams. Ensure learning and performance-support materials are accurate, commercially relevant, easy to use in the flow of work, and maintained as platforms, processes, and AI-enabled client solutions evolve. Adoption Measurement and Reinforcement Define readiness and adoption goals, leading indicators, usage measures, and qualitative feedback mechanisms for technology and process launches and for field enablement supporting AI-enabled client solutions. Use data from Gong, Salesforce, learning platforms, and other sources to evaluate adoption, identify friction, and recommend targeted reinforcement. Distinguish activity from effective use by assessing whether tools, AI-enabled workflows, and field practices are improving seller productivity, execution quality, manager visibility, data quality, and commercial outcomes. Establish feedback loops with the field and functional owners, including Technology & Talent and AI Client Solutions partners, and convert insights into workflow improvements, updated guidance, and ongoing reinforcement. Enablement Operations Help establish a consistent intake and prioritization process for technology, systems, and sales-process enablement requests. Maintain visibility into upcoming commercial launches and dependencies so Enablement can engage at the right point rather than after implementation. Contribute to enablement planning, program governance, documentation standards, reporting, and the ongoing evolution of the Enablement technology ecosystem. Qualifications Seven or more years of experience in sales enablement, revenue enablement, sales operations, revenue operations, commercial excellence, or a related function, including substantial ownership of technology or process adoption. Deep working knowledge of Gong, including how conversation intelligence, workflows, coaching, and usage data can support seller and manager effectiveness. Strong Salesforce or comparable CRM expertise and a practical understanding of opportunity management, pipeline, forecasting, sales stages, and data discipline. Experience with sales engagement and prospecting technologies such as Clay, as well as generative AI tools including ChatGPT and other emerging commercial AI capabilities; able to help sellers apply AI practically across the sales workflow and quickly build fluency in AI-enabled offerings to translate complex solution concepts into clear commercial guidance for the field. Demonstrated ability to map seller workflows, diagnose adoption barriers, and translate complex systems and processes into simple, usable field guidance. Experience creating self-paced learning, videos, live demonstrations, job aids, and manager-led reinforcement materials. Strong cross-functional influence and the ability to work credibly with Sales, Operations, Technology, Marketing, Product, and senior leaders without relying on direct authority. Strong project management, communication, facilitation, and analytical skills, with the judgment to select the right intervention rather than defaulting to training. Preferred Experience Experience supporting a complex B2B sales organization with multiple sales motions, segments, or geographies. Experience supporting enterprise technology launches, AI-enabled seller workflows, commercial transformation initiatives, or field enablement for technology- or AI-enabled solutions. Experience using adoption and performance data to improve enablement programs and influence system or process design. Experience with learning platforms, digital adoption tools, content management, or enablement platforms. Success Measures Commercial technology and process initiatives include an activation and adoption strategy before launch, and AI-enabled client solutions have a clear field-readiness approach for sellers and managers. Managers have the context, capability, and materials to activate new workflows with their teams. Sellers can use core technologies and AI confidently in the flow of work to improve productivity and execution, and can identify relevant client needs, position Axiom's AI-enabled solutions at the appropriate level, articulate value, and engage the right subject matter experts when deeper solution expertise is required. Adoption is measured through meaningful usage, quality, and behavior indicators, with targeted reinforcement when results fall short. Enablement has early visibility into commercial initiatives and evolving AI-enabled client solutions and engages selectively where it can materially improve field execution and business outcomes. Axiom’s total rewards philosophy is to be transparent and equitable with all job candidates. The salary range for this Senior Manager-level U.S.-based remote role is $180,000–$222,000 OTE. You can also participate in our benefits programs, which include healthcare, life and disability coverage, a 401(k) with company match, paid sick and personal time off, paid parental leave, and more. Please note that final compensation is determined by several considerations, including the quality of your experience and expertise, your ability to immediately contribute to Axiom, your potential to progress to the next level, the market in which you are located, and other business considerations. Accommodation for Individuals with Disabilities: Upon request and consistent with applicable laws, Axiom will attempt to provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities who require an accommodation to participate in the application process. To request an accommodation to complete the application form, please contact us at benefits@axiomlaw.com and include “Applicant Accommodation” in the subject line. #LI-NS2

jobs.title: Business Development Representative (North America)
jobs.description: 🌀 The Company Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action. Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action. At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative. As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future. 🎯 The Role We’re looking for a Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our Revenue team and help us expand Filigran’s footprint across the North America region . Your mission is to identify, engage, and qualify new enterprise opportunities — fueling our growth by connecting security leaders with Filigran’s open-source and commercial solutions. You’ll collaborate closely with Sales and Marketing to turn market interest into meaningful conversations, driving the pipeline that powers Filigran’s mission to make cyber defense more proactive and connected. 💼 Your Responsibilities Identify, research, and engage potential enterprise customers across the NA region. Proactively generate outbound opportunities through targeted outreach. Build relationships with CISOs, security engineers, and threat intelligence professionals. Qualify prospects through outreach (phone calls, emails, social media) and structured lead scoring to ensure strong fit and intent. Collaborate with Account Executives to book and hand off high-quality meetings that lead to new revenue. Maintain accurate and organized activity tracking within HubSpot. Partner with Marketing to refine messaging, campaigns, and regional strategies. Represent Filigran at virtual and regional industry events to expand awareness and engagement. 🤝 Who You’ll Work With Reports directly to Sam Weiss, Manager – BDR Collaborates daily with Account Executives and Marketing teams Works closely with the global Revenue organization to align on pipeline goals and regional strategies Joins a team that values collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement 🧬 Profile We’re Looking For 1+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, ideally in cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise software Track record of success in outbound prospecting and lead qualification Excellent communication and presentation skills across multiple cultures and time zones Comfortable working in a remote, async-first environment Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and resilience in a fast-paced environment Familiarity with HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar tools Bonus: Experience engaging enterprise customers in the NA market or cybersecurity domain knowledge 🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job. We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company , and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation . You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem. ⭐ Be part of something bigger We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative. 💻 Work at the edge of what’s next We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice. 🌍 Global opportunity without borders Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us. 🧭 A culture grounded in CORE Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching. 💰 What you can expect Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen 🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture. At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status. What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify. 🚀 Ready to Join Us? Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Success
jobs.description: ABOUT US Trusted by 800,000 monthly active users, UpCodes (YC S17) is a comprehensive compliance and product research platform that accelerates design to construction in the AEC space. The construction industry suffers from unnecessary costs and complexity; every year billions of dollars are wasted on rework. We’re committed to delivering easy-to-use tools that help designers and builders spend less time finding the right compliance and product resources and more time doing what they love — designing and building. We make a real-world, tangible impact on the lives of our users and their work of constructing our homes, schools, hospitals, and offices. ABOUT THE ROLE UpCodes has grown organically across architecture firms, government agencies, and key players in the AEC industry. We have one Customer Success Manager today, and we’re hiring our first Manager of Customer Success to shape how the function works from here. You’ll define how we measure customer health, set targets for the team, and create the processes that allow Customer Success to scale with our customer base. You’ll also stay hands-on with customers while the team grows. WHAT YOU'LL DO As Manager of Customer Success, you’ll have a direct and significant impact on how our customers succeed with UpCodes and how we grow with them. You’ll be responsible for: Team Leadership: Manage and mentor our current CSM, and plan, hire, and train a high-performing team as we grow, ensuring alignment with cross-functional teams such as Sales, Support, and Product. Hands-On Leadership: Until the team is in place, you’ll be on customer calls, running onboardings and trainings, and handling escalations. You’ll stay hands-on as the team grows. Strategy and KPIs: Work backward from company priorities to set goals for the team. Evaluate our current metrics, such as retention, expansion, and adoption, set ambitious targets for improvement, and lead the team in achieving them. Customer Health: Develop a customer health score based on product usage, engagement, and renewal signals, and monitor it regularly to flag at-risk revenue and expansion opportunities early. Scalable Systems: Create the playbooks, workflows, and automations that enable the team to efficiently support a growing customer base. Customer Knowledge Base: Build and maintain a knowledge base of guides and help articles so customers can find answers on their own. Reporting and Dashboards: Build reports and dashboards that give the team and leadership clear visibility into customer health and trends. jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Account Executive (Federal)
jobs.description: About Keyfactor Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor! Title: Enterprise Sales Account Executive, Federal (formal title is Sales Director, Federal) Location: United States, Washington DC Metro Area (Remote) Experience: Senior Level Job Function: Sales Employment Type: Full-time Industry: Computer and Network Security About the position Keyfactor is seeking a Federal Sales Director to lead and grow our public sector business across U.S. federal civilian, defense, and intelligence agencies. In this role, you will own the federal go-to-market strategy for Keyfactor digital trust solutions, in your assigned territory. You will work as part of a high-performing federal sales team, develop strategic relationships with agency stakeholders, system integrators, and channel partners, and navigate the federal procurement landscape, including contract vehicles, compliance requirements, and long-cycle opportunities. You will be accountable for pipeline development, forecasting, and revenue attainment, and will work closely with Marketing, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Legal to position Keyfactor as a trusted partner in the federal market. The ideal candidate brings a proven record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder federal deals, deep familiarity with how agencies buy, and credibility with technical and executive audiences. Experience in cybersecurity, identity, or cryptography is strongly preferred. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Responsibilities • Understands and contributes to contract negotiations. • Delivers reliable forecasts and accurate reporting for the territory. • Collaborates with marketing to build out the go-to-market (GTM) strategy. • Manages pipeline over long sales cycles. • Develops new accounts while maintaining and sustaining successful long-term relationships with key decision-makers up to and including the C-level. • Contributes to the development of product, market, and competitor knowledge. • Participates in events and tradeshows. • Maintains a commitment to the company’s sales processes, values, and target visions. Minimum Qualifications, Education, and Skills • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Technology, or equivalent experience. • Strong understanding of IT security, PKI, and certificate lifecycle management. • In-depth knowledge of market dynamics and competitor strategies. • Familiarity with regulatory requirements in the IT Security industry. • Experience with and knowledge of MEDDPICC, Solution Selling, and SPIN Selling. • Ability to develop and execute strategic direction aligned with company goals. • Proficient in using advanced sales tools and technologies. • Ability to identify and develop opportunities for future business growth, including strategically important partnerships and key customers. • Ability to coach others and share knowledge, insights, and skills with the broader team. • Ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Compensation Salary will be commensurate with experience. Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas. Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special: Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change. Comprehensive benefit coverage globally. Paid Parental Leave is available to new parents. Structure varies based on regional/government requirements. In regions where government-paid leave doesn’t exist, like in the U.S., the company offers generous paid parental leave, along with comprehensive adoption and fertility support. Competitive time off globally. Dedicated employee-focused ambassadors via Key Contributors & Culture Committees. DIVERSE Commitment, a call to action for a more inclusive and diverse future in business, society, and technology. The Keyfactor Alliance Program to support DEIB efforts. Wellbeing resources, wellness allowance, mindfulness app free membership, Wellness Wednesdays. Global Volunteer Day, company non-profit matching, and 3 volunteer days off. Monthly Talent development and Cross Functional meetings to support professional development. Regular All Hands meetings – followed by group gatherings. Our Core Values Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member: Trust is paramount. We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business. Customers are core. We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own. Innovation never stops, it only accelerates. The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve. We deliver with agility . We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals. United by respect . Respect for all is what unites us. We promote diversity, inclusivity, equity, and acting with empathy and openness, both in our business and in our communities. Teams make “it” happen. Vision and goals are not individually achievable – they require teamwork. We pride ourselves in operating as a cohesive team, creating promoters and partners, and winning as one. Keyfactor is a proud equal opportunity employer including but not limited to veterans and individuals with disabilities. REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION: Applicants with disabilities may contact a member of Keyfactor’s People team via people@keyfactor.com and/or telephone at 1.216.785.2990 to request and arrange for accommodations at any time.
